instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show the captions of a listening and fix a word, a speaker or a line in them", and give it listening (The listening's name).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:caption-what-is-heard and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Answers the last captions of a listening from its heard rows, with the person's corrections applied, after applying the caption ops given: on, off, edit { id, text }, speaker { id, name }, hide { id }, show { id }, undo { id }.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: heard (records:list); captions (records:read, records:write).
